description.short_caption: Axial chest CT showing bilateral lung abnormalities.
description.detailed_description: This axial chest CT image displays both lungs with significant abnormalities. The lung parenchyma exhibits diffuse areas of increased opacity, consistent with consolidation or ground-glass opacities. There is evidence of bilateral involvement, with the abnormalities appearing more prominent in the lower lobes. The image is de-identified and presented in a circular format, typical of older CT imaging systems.

description.short_caption: GMS stain of transbronchial biopsy showing fungal elements (100x magnification).
description.detailed_description: This image shows a transbronchial biopsy stained with Gomori methenamine silver (GMS) at 100x magnification. The background consists of lung tissue with pale green staining, typical of GMS. Dark, round to oval fungal elements are visible, consistent with yeast forms. These fungal structures are highlighted in black against the green-stained tissue, aiding in identification.
visible_findings: lung tissue stained green with GMS
dark oval fungal elements consistent with yeast forms
contrast between fungal structures and tissue background

description.short_caption: GMS stain of transbronchial biopsy showing fungal elements (100x magnification).
description.detailed_description: This image shows a transbronchial biopsy stained with Gomori methenamine silver (GMS) at 100x magnification. The tissue exhibits fungal elements, including a prominent round structure consistent with a fungal spore. The background consists of lung parenchyma with light green staining, typical of GMS highlighting fungal cell walls. The dark staining of the fungal elements contrasts sharply with the surrounding tissue.
visible_findings: contrast between fungal elements and surrounding tissue

Case_03023/figure2.jpg.source_caption: Hematoxylin and eosin stain of transbronchial biopsy (20x).

description.short_caption: Hematoxylin and eosin stain of transbronchial biopsy showing lung parenchyma with inflammation.
description.detailed_description: This histopathology image shows lung parenchyma stained with hematoxylin and eosin at 20x magnification. The tissue demonstrates areas of inflammation with cellular infiltrates, including lymphocytes and possibly other inflammatory cells, within the interstitial spaces. There are also alveolar spaces visible, some of which appear collapsed or partially filled. The overall architecture suggests an inflammatory process, potentially consistent with an infectious or interstitial lung condition.
visible_findings: inflammatory cellular infiltrates in interstitial spaces
alveolar spaces, some collapsed or partially filled
